headline: Early observations and latest-benchmark reference only; not live opening quotes. Each figure carries its own effective date.
nigeria_note: CBN benchmark rates are those of 22 Oct (23 Oct not yet posted; the NFEM average reflects interbank deals only). Nigeria parallel-market figures are withheld: only one current independent observation could be verified at preparation, and AMB requires at least two. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources.
markets_note: Latest official reference values with effective dates: Ghana mid of Bank of Ghana buy/sell (22 Oct); Kenya CBK commercial-banks’ average closing rates (market close 21 Oct, posted 22 Oct, 23 Oct not yet posted; not a standalone buy or sell quote); South Africa SARB weighted-average bank rates (22 Oct, carried forward: SARB endpoint unreachable at preparation); Egypt mid of CBE buy/sell (21 Oct, carried forward: CBE request rejected at preparation).
